digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity scoring and deterministic floor
propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than adherence to author guide contracts, allowing padded plans to pass without required sections like grounded Scope or per-criterion verification
Clarity checks are duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without a single source of truth, creating drift risk when extending deterministic criteria

Documented plan-writing guidance and current deterministic clarity inputs lack a mapped comparison; mechanically testable criteria exist for required-section structure, AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, and grounded edit-sets but are not implemented
Author guide requires rejected-alternative wording while authoritative G6 does not; this conflict (bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82) must be resolved before encoding clarity checks for Approach section
Documentation for Success Criteria in containers conflicts with active ticket 1386, which collapses it into Acceptance Criteria; this must be clarified to avoid encoding inert checks
